items.title: Sun Almanac — deterministic 7-day Director forecast for appointment gameplay
items.why: The Director already derives today's pressure, modifiers, and route bias from a date seed — which means tomorrow's are already computable. Publishing a 7-day forecast (shrine-heavy days, rival surges, boss-pressure peaks) turns the Daily Rite into appointment gameplay: players plan offerings around known good days and return on the days that favor their build. No live-service game in this category gives players a deterministic weather report for the dungeon itself.
items.recipe: Add src/game/almanac.js that maps date+worldState through the existing Director seed path for the next 7 days; export forecast through chronicle/status contracts; surface a compact Almanac strip on the Daily Rite tab; tests assert determinism and zero token cost.

items.title: Sundial Queue — offline outbox that converts the Supabase blocker into a feature
items.why: The SUPABASE_DB_URL blocker means hardened RPCs may stay undeployed for a while; today, disconnected shared-world writes are simply local. A trust-sanitized outbox that queues graves, offerings, echoes, and reactions with receipts — and flushes through the RPC-first path the moment the backend link goes live — means the day Carter adds the secret, every player's accumulated light syncs into the chronicle at once. The blocker becomes a launch moment instead of dead time.
items.recipe: Add src/game/sundialQueue.js (enqueue via trust sanitizers, capped, deduped, receipt-emitting); wire sharedWorldService to enqueue on disconnected writes and flush on backend connect; tests cover queue caps, sanitization, flush ordering, and receipt emission.

items.title: Legacy Vows — pre-run pledges that amplify or dim your grave's legacy
items.why: Deaths already leave graves that form constellations, but every death is narratively identical. A deterministic vow chosen before a run (reach the boss unaided, spend nothing at shrines, finish under the bell) gives each death an authored epitaph: kept vows amplify the grave's constellation offering value, broken vows dim it. This deepens the death-as-content loop that is Solara's core identity and feeds existing systems (constellations, receipts, share lines) without new backend needs.
items.recipe: Add src/game/vows.js with seeded vow offers per rite, keep/break evaluation from run stats, and legacy multipliers; wire vow selection into Daily Rite start and evaluation into debrief + grave payload; tests cover vow determinism, evaluation, and legacy math.

items.title: Director Memory — 'the Sun remembers you': personal adaptive pressure
items.why: The Director reacts to the community but is amnesiac about the individual. A rolling local record of recent runs (deaths, clears, pace) deterministically biasing personal route danger and reward tells makes difficulty self-tuning with zero server or token cost — and the copy 'the Sun remembers your last three falls' is pure Solara mythology doing mechanical work.
items.recipe: Add src/game/directorMemory.js with a clientStore-backed rolling window and a deterministic bias function consumed by directorMechanics route tuning; surface one remembrance line in the route brief; tests cover window math and bias bounds.

items.title: Chronicle Scenes — 'The Myth So Far' deterministic vignette composer
items.why: Chronicle data is rich (crises, rituals, rivals, constellations, receipts) but reads as feeds and stats. A seeded template-grammar composer that renders the same events as short mythic vignettes gives new players a one-screen 'story so far' and gives returning players their session delta as narrative — deterministic AI as authorship, no tokens, fully within the 2026-04-17 policy.
items.recipe: Add src/game/chronicleScenes.js with a seeded grammar over chronicle/world-feed entries producing 3-5 vignette lines with identity-safe naming; surface as a Myth So Far panel on the front door and in chronicle exports; tests assert determinism and naming safety.

items.title: Last Light challenge links — shareable deterministic route challenges
items.why: Share lines exist but are one-way text. Encoding today's rite seed plus your result into a compact URL token lets a friend open the same deterministic route with a 'beat their light' banner — an organic acquisition loop that costs nothing, needs no backend, and makes every debrief card a recruitment surface.
items.recipe: Add src/game/challengeLinks.js to encode/decode {date, seed, score, vow} URL tokens with validation; read the param at boot to arm a challenge banner and stamp the debrief comparison; tests cover round-trip encoding, tamper rejection, and date expiry.

items.title: Deterministic fuzz harness for save import sanitization
items.why: Import/export is the highest-risk untrusted input path after public writes, and current tests cover happy paths. A seeded fuzz harness throwing structured garbage (wrong types, hostile strings, huge arrays, prototype pollution shapes) at the save migration/sanitization pipeline locks in resilience before the next round of save-touching features.
items.recipe: Add tests/save-fuzz.test.mjs with a seeded generator over malformed payloads asserting sanitize/migrate never throws, never emits oversized fields, and always lands on the current save version.

items.title: Text-scale setting plus HUD hierarchy pass
items.why: The board has flagged readability and mobile affordances for three sessions running. A persisted text-scale setting (clientStore) applied via a root CSS variable plus a contrast/size pass on the densest HUD strips is the cheapest accessibility win that touches every minute of play.
items.recipe: Add a text-scale option in settings persisted through clientStore, applied as a root font-size variable; bump the lowest-contrast HUD labels found in the pass.

items.title: Manual chunk split for lore/menu panels
items.why: Supabase is already lazy, but display-only panels (MenuLorePanels and peers) still ride the main bundle. A manualChunks hint plus React.lazy on the heaviest display-only components trims first-load cost on the path new players actually hit.
items.recipe: Add rollup manualChunks for menu/lore components and lazy-load MenuLorePanels; verify with build output size comparison before/after.
